titulo: Pakistan detains hundreds of politicians from Imran Khan’s PTI party
cuerpo: President Zardari suspends provincial government in escalation of tensions as Khan supporters march to Islamabad Politicians from ⁠the party of the former Pakistani ​prime minister Imran Khan have been detained after the suspension of a provincial government now under emergency rule.
